name: Assembly HOA
long_description:
Assembly is an AI-native HOA management company on a mission to fix homeowner associations. Traditional HOA management is often reactive, confusing, and inefficient. Assembly takes a different approach by combining professional expertise with intelligent software to make communities run smoothly and decisions easier.

We exist to build trust, create transparency, and ensure well-run communities that protect and enhance property values.

Assembly simplifies day-to-day operations, automates routine tasks, and delivers the right knowledge at the right time. Our platform gives boards and homeowners clarity to make smarter, more confident decisions. 

We manage HOAs in San Francisco Bay Area and Greater Los Angeles.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Allen has a background in real estate and startups. He worked as a real estate agent for several years, managing client relationships and transactions. In startups, he specialized in customer success and implementation, focusing on improving client experiences and efficiency.

Growing up in a townhome community, Allen has firsthand insight into HOA governance challenges and opportunities. This perspective, combined with his expertise, drives his passion for creating innovative HOA management.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Shreyas has a strong background in AI/ML, having worked as a data scientist at startups and most recently at the RAND Corporation, where he developed experimental ML products for the DoD.

His journey with HOAs began with his own condo ownership, where encountering massive inefficiencies in community operations led him to join the HOA board. At Assembly, Shreyas leverages his technical expertise and passion for safeguarding homeowners' investments to build the next-generation of HOA management.

launches.title: 🏘️ Assembly HOA: Modern tech-enabled HOA management
launches.tagline: Your HOA probably sucks. We can help.
launches.body:
TL;DR; [Assembly](https://assemblyhoa.com/) provides tech-enabled HOA management for your community and [Atlas](https://atlas.assemblyhoa.com/sign-in), a free AI-copilot to help you navigate your HOA.

[Allen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/allenliou1/) and [Shreyas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shreyas-assembly/) here from Assembly!

We started Assembly because we were fed up with slow, inefficient, and costly HOAs that often make homeowners feel like renters, powerless against poor management. What’s the point of homeownership if you feel this way?

Assembly leverages the latest in fintech and AI to automate HOA operations and provide real-time information to homeowners. Our cutting-edge software, combined with top-tier HOA managers, ensures that your most valuable asset is protected while delivering a modern, transparent experience you’d expect in 2024.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82995&key=user_uploads/383321/c99c2211-0986-4274-a34b-2471debedbf8)

We’re live with 26 communities across Greater Los Angeles and SF Bay Area and a [4\.9 star rating on Google.](https://g.co/kgs/kYqnUpb)

**Ask:** If you or anyone you know is an HOA board member or a homeowner struggling with their HOA, we’d love to bring your HOA over to Assembly! Please reach out to us at 213 282 8809 or [allen@assemblyhoa.com](mailto:allen@assemblyhoa.com) to learn how we can help or book time directly: <https://calendly.com/allenliouhoa/chat>

### But wait, there’s more!

To help any homeowner faster than waiting for the HOA to switch HOA management companies, we’re launching Assembly Atlas, your free AI HOA copilot to help you navigate your HOA. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82995&key=user_uploads/383321/e676505c-c487-4d70-8596-8ee0566e2745)

Atlas reads through your HOA’s governing documents (CC&Rs, Bylaws, and Rules & Regs) and generates simple cards to help you get clarity about what you can and can’t do in your community. You can also ask Atlas directly if you have other questions or want to go into more detail.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82995&key=user_uploads/383321/c5a6eee8-f635-45b6-b8d4-9d1428fec34f)

**Ask:** Try or share Atlas with any homeowners you know: <https://atlas.assemblyhoa.com/> and let us know your thoughts ([founders@assemblyhoa.com](mailto:founders@assemblyhoa.com)).
